content:
people-ops-bot: Announcement: org change + new hire intro for Capacity & Ops rota pilot. Details below.

Clara Ruiz: Quick update  launching a 10-week cross-team rotation pilot between Capacity and Serving Ops to improve handoffs. Hana Park joins as Senior Capacity Manager and will own the pilot program.

Hana Park: Hi all  excited to join Redwood! For the pilot I'll pair two capacity engineers with two serving operators for 6-week rotations, run a weekly retro, and deliver a short playbook. Happy to meet folks 1:1.

Diego Morales: Welcome Hana! Operational question: will this change oncall assignments or just shadowing? Need to avoid doubling oncall.

Clara Ruiz: Good catch. This is shadow-first: no change to primary oncall. Rotators will shadow and get runbook access, then step into escalations only with a dedicated pairing window.

Priya Natarajan: People Ops note: Hana reports to Clara. We're opening two fixed-term backfills (Capacity Eng contractor, 10 weeks) and one internal shadow slot. Internal applicants get interview fast-track; link in #jobs.

Amir Patel: Can we gate any rollout of regional pools on completion of the first rotation? That might reduce rework from misrouted capacity.

Clara Ruiz: Agreed. We'll add that as a soft checkpoint: major regional rollouts should have at least one completed rotation pair and a signed-off playbook.

Hana Park: Timeline: Week 0 onboarding; Weeks 1-6 rotation #1; Week 7 retro + playbook draft; Weeks 8-10 iterate and handoff. I'll post a signup sheet for internal volunteers this afternoon.

Diego Morales: I'll volunteer one engineer for rotation #1. Also please ensure access to fleet scheduling dashboards is granted before Week 1.

Priya Natarajan: Action items: people-ops to post reqs and internal signup; Hana to publish rotation schedule and playbook template; Clara to add soft checkpoint to regional rollout guidance.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: react with :raising_hand: if you want to volunteer for the rotation or with :eyes: if you'll review the playbook.
